verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ ὁ ἀρχιερεύς Εἰ ταῦτα οὕτως ἔχει
verses.transliteration: Eipen de ho archiereus Ei tauta houtōs echei
verses.literal: Then the high priest asked Stephen Are these charges true
verses.literalPt: E DISSE o sumo sacerdote: Porventura é isto assim?

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἔφη Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοὶ καὶ πατέρες ἀκούσατε Ὁ Θεὸς τῆς δόξης ὤφθη τῷ πατρὶ ἡμῶν Ἀβραὰμ ὄντι ἐν τῇ Μεσοποταμίᾳ πρὶν ἢ κατοικῆσαι αὐτὸν ἐν Χαρράν
verses.transliteration: Ho de ephē Andres adelphoi kai pateres akousate HO Theos tēs doxēs ōphthē tō patri hēmōn Abraam onti en tē Mesopotamia prin ē katoikēsai auton en Charran
verses.literal: And Stephen declared Brothers and fathers listen to me The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia before . . . he lived in Haran
verses.literalPt: E ele disse: Homens, irmãos, e pais, ouvi. O Deus da glória apareceu a nosso pai Abraão, estando na Mesopotâmia, antes de habitar em Harã,

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν Ἔξελθε ἐκ τῆς γῆς σου καὶ ἐκ τῆς συγγενείας σου καὶ δεῦρο εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ἄν σοι δείξω
verses.transliteration: kai eipen pros auton Exelthe ek tēs gēs sou kai ek tēs syngeneias sou kai deuro eis tēn gēn hēn an soi deixō
verses.literal: and told . . . him Leave . . . your country and your kindred and go to the land - I will show you
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhe: Sai da tua terra e dentre a tua parentela, e dirige-te à terra que eu te mostrar.

verses.original: τότε ἐξελθὼν ἐκ γῆς Χαλδαίων κατῴκησεν ἐν Χαρράν κἀκεῖθεν μετὰ τὸ ἀποθανεῖν τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ μετῴκισεν αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν γῆν ταύτην εἰς ἣν ὑμεῖς νῦν κατοικεῖτε
verses.transliteration: tote exelthōn ek gēs Chaldaiōn katōkēsen en Charran kakeithen meta to apothanein ton patera autou metōkisen auton eis tēn gēn tautēn eis hēn hymeis nyn katoikeite
verses.literal: So Abraham left . . . the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran After his father died God brought him out of that place and into this land where you are now living
verses.literalPt: Então saiu da terra dos caldeus, e habitou em Harã. E dali, depois que seu pai faleceu, Deus o trouxe para esta terra em que habitais agora.

verses.original: Καὶ οὐκ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ κληρονομίαν ἐν αὐτῇ οὐδὲ βῆμα ποδός καὶ ἐπηγγείλατο δοῦναι αὐτῷ εἰς κατάσχεσιν αὐτὴν καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ μετ’ αὐτόν οὐκ ὄντος αὐτῷ τέκνου
verses.transliteration: Kai ouk edōken autō klēronomian en autē oude bēma podos kai epēngeilato dounai autō eis kataschesin autēn kai tō spermati autou met’ auton ouk ontos autō teknou
verses.literal: He gave him no inheritance here not even a foot of ground . . . But God promised to give . . . possession of the land to Abraham and his descendants . . . . . . even though he did not yet have . . . . . . a child
verses.literalPt: E não lhe deu nela herança, nem ainda o espaço de um pé; mas prometeu que lhe daria a posse dela, e depois dele, à sua descendência, não tendo ele ainda filho.

verses.original: ἐλάλησεν δὲ οὕτως ὁ Θεὸς ὅτι ἔσται τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ πάροικον ἐν γῇ ἀλλοτρίᾳ καὶ δουλώσουσιν αὐτὸ καὶ κακώσουσιν ἔτη τετρακόσια
verses.transliteration: elalēsen de houtōs ho Theos hoti estai to sperma autou paroikon en gē allotria kai doulōsousin auto kai kakōsousin etē tetrakosia
verses.literal: God told him that his descendants would be foreigners in a strange land and that they would be enslaved . . . and mistreated four hundred years
verses.literalPt: E falou Deus assim: Que a sua descendência seria peregrina em terra alheia, e a sujeitariam à escravidão, e a maltratariam por quatrocentos anos.

verses.original: Καὶ τὸ ἔθνος ᾧ ἐὰν δουλεύσουσιν κρινῶ ἐγώ ὁ Θεὸς εἶπεν Καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἐξελεύσονται καὶ λατρεύσουσίν μοι ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τούτῳ
verses.transliteration: Kai to ethnos hō ean douleusousin krinō egō ho Theos eipen Kai meta tauta exeleusontai kai latreusousin moi en tō topō toutō
verses.literal: But I will punish the nation that enslaves them God said and afterward . . . they will come forth and worship Me in this place
verses.literalPt: E eu julgarei a nação que os tiver escravizado, disse Deus. E depois disto sairão e me servirão neste lugar.

verses.original: Καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ διαθήκην περιτομῆς καὶ οὕτως ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰσαὰκ καὶ περιέτεμεν αὐτὸν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ τὸν Ἰακώβ καὶ Ἰακὼβ τοὺς δώδεκα πατριάρχας
verses.transliteration: Kai edōken autō diathēkēn peritomēs kai houtōs egennēsen ton Isaak kai perietemen auton tē hēmera tē ogdoē kai Isaak ton Iakōb kai Iakōb tous dōdeka patriarchas
verses.literal: Then God gave Abraham the covenant of circumcision and Abraham became the father of Isaac and circumcised him on the eighth day And Isaac became the father of Jacob and Jacob of the twelve patriarchs
verses.literalPt: E deu-lhe a aliança da circuncisão; e assim gerou a Isaque, e o circuncidou ao oitavo dia; e Isaque a Jacó; e Jacó aos doze patriarcas.

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ πατριάρχαι ζηλώσαντες τὸν Ἰωσὴφ ἀπέδοντο εἰς Αἴγυπτον καὶ ἦν ὁ Θεὸς μετ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi patriarchai zēlōsantes ton Iōsēph apedonto eis Aigypton kai ēn ho Theos met’ autou
verses.literal: Because the patriarchs were jealous of Joseph they sold him as a slave into Egypt But God was with him
verses.literalPt: E os patriarcas, movidos de inveja, venderam José para o Egito; mas Deus era com ele.

verses.original: καὶ ἐξείλατο αὐτὸν ἐκ πασῶν τῶν θλίψεων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ χάριν καὶ σοφίαν ἐναντίον Φαραὼ βασιλέως Αἰγύπτου καὶ κατέστησεν αὐτὸν ἡγούμενον ἐπ’ Αἴγυπτον καὶ ἐφ’ ὅλον τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai exeilato auton ek pasōn tōn thlipseōn autou kai edōken autō charin kai sophian enantion Pharaō basileōs Aigyptou kai katestēsen auton hēgoumenon ep’ Aigypton kai eph’ holon ton oikon autou
verses.literal: and rescued him from all his troubles He granted Joseph favor and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt who appointed him ruler over Egypt and all his household
verses.literalPt: E livrou-o de todas as suas tribulações, e lhe deu graça e sabedoria ante Faraó, rei do Egito, que o constituiu governador sobre o Egito e toda a sua casa.

verses.original: Ἦλθεν δὲ λιμὸς ἐφ’ ὅλην τὴν Αἴγυπτον καὶ Χανάαν καὶ θλῖψις μεγάλη καὶ οὐχ ηὕρισκον χορτάσματα οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ēlthen de limos eph’ holēn tēn Aigypton kai Chanaan kai thlipsis megalē kai ouch hēuriskon chortasmata hoi pateres hēmōn
verses.literal: Then famine and great suffering swept across Egypt and Canaan and our fathers could not find food
verses.literalPt: Sobreveio então a todo o país do Egito e de Canaã fome e grande tribulação; e nossos pais não achavam alimentos.

verses.original: ἀκούσας δὲ Ἰακὼβ ὄντα σιτία εἰς Αἴγυπτον ἐξαπέστειλεν τοὺς πατέρας ἡμῶν πρῶτον
verses.transliteration: akousas de Iakōb onta sitia eis Aigypton exapesteilen tous pateras hēmōn prōton
verses.literal: When Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt he sent our fathers on their first visit
verses.literalPt: Mas tendo ouvido Jacó que no Egito havia trigo, enviou ali nossos pais, a primeira vez.

verses.original: καὶ ἐν τῷ δευτέρῳ ἀνεγνωρίσθη Ἰωσὴφ τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ φανερὸν ἐγένετο τῷ Φαραὼ τὸ γένος τοῦ Ἰωσήφ
verses.transliteration: kai en tō deuterō anegnōristhē Iōsēph tois adelphois autou kai phaneron egeneto tō Pharaō to genos tou Iōsēph
verses.literal: On their second visit Joseph revealed his identity to his brothers and his family became known to Pharaoh
verses.literalPt: E na segunda vez foi José conhecido por seus irmãos, e a sua linhagem foi manifesta a Faraó.

verses.original: ἀποστείλας δὲ Ἰωσὴφ μετεκαλέσατο Ἰακὼβ τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν συγγένειαν ἐν ψυχαῖς ἑβδομήκοντα πέντε
verses.transliteration: aposteilas de Iōsēph metekalesato Iakōb ton patera autou kai pasan tēn syngeneian en psychais hebdomēkonta pente
verses.literal: Then Joseph sent for . . . his father Jacob and all his relatives seventy-five . . . . . . in all
verses.literalPt: E José mandou chamar a seu pai Jacó, e a toda a sua parentela, que era de setenta e cinco almas.

verses.original: Καὶ κατέβη Ἰακὼβ εἰς Αἴγυπτον καὶ ἐτελεύτησεν αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai katebē Iakōb eis Aigypton kai eteleutēsen autos kai hoi pateres hēmōn
verses.literal: So Jacob went down to Egypt where he and our fathers died
verses.literalPt: E Jacó desceu ao Egito, e morreu, ele e nossos pais;

verses.original: καὶ μετετέθησαν εἰς Συχὲμ καὶ ἐτέθησαν ἐν τῷ μνήματι ᾧ ὠνήσατο Ἀβραὰμ τιμῆς ἀργυρίου παρὰ τῶν υἱῶν Ἑμμὼρ ἐν Συχέμ
verses.transliteration: kai metetethēsan eis Sychem kai etethēsan en tō mnēmati hō ōnēsato Abraam timēs argyriou para tōn huiōn Hemmōr en Sychem
verses.literal: Their bones were carried back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor at Shechem for a price he paid in silver
verses.literalPt: E foram transportados para Siquém, e depositados na sepultura que Abraão comprara por certa soma de dinheiro aos filhos de Emor, pai de Siquém.

verses.original: Καθὼς δὲ ἤγγιζεν ὁ χρόνος τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ἧς ὡμολόγησεν ὁ Θεὸς τῷ Ἀβραάμ ηὔξησεν ὁ λαὸς καὶ ἐπληθύνθη ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ
verses.transliteration: Kathōs de ēngizen ho chronos tēs epangelias hēs hōmologēsen ho Theos tō Abraam ēuxēsen ho laos kai eplēthynthē en Aigyptō
verses.literal: As the time drew near for God to fulfill His promise . . . to Abraham our people in Egypt increased greatly in number
verses.literalPt: Aproximando-se, porém, o tempo da promessa que Deus tinha feito a Abraão, o povo cresceu e se multiplicou no Egito;

verses.original: ἄχρι οὗ ἀνέστη βασιλεὺς ἕτερος ἐπ’ Αἴγυπτον ὃς οὐκ ᾔδει τὸν Ἰωσήφ
verses.transliteration: achri hou anestē basileus heteros ep’ Aigypton hos ouk ēdei ton Iōsēph
verses.literal: Then . . . another king who knew nothing of Joseph arose over Egypt
verses.literalPt: Até que se levantou outro rei, que não conhecia a José.

verses.original: οὗτος κατασοφισάμενος τὸ γένος ἡμῶν ἐκάκωσεν τοὺς πατέρας ἡμῶν τοῦ ποιεῖν τὰ βρέφη ἔκθετα αὐτῶν εἰς τὸ μὴ ζωογονεῖσθαι
verses.transliteration: houtos katasophisamenos to genos hēmōn ekakōsen tous pateras hēmōn tou poiein ta brephē ektheta autōn eis to mē zōogoneisthai
verses.literal: He exploited our people and oppressed our fathers forcing them to abandon their infants so . . . they would die
verses.literalPt: Esse, usando de astúcia contra a nossa linhagem, maltratou nossos pais, a ponto de os fazer enjeitar as suas crianças, para que não se multiplicassem.

verses.original: Ἐν ᾧ καιρῷ ἐγεννήθη Μωϋσῆς καὶ ἦν ἀστεῖος τῷ Θεῷ ὃς ἀνετράφη μῆνας τρεῖς ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ πατρός
verses.transliteration: En hō kairō egennēthē Mōusēs kai ēn asteios tō Theō hos anetraphē mēnas treis en tō oikō tou patros
verses.literal: At that time Moses was born and he was beautiful in the sight of God For three months he was nurtured in his father’s house
verses.literalPt: Nesse tempo nasceu Moisés, e era mui formoso, e foi criado três meses em casa de seu pai.

verses.original: ἐκτεθέντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἀνείλατο αὐτὸν ἡ θυγάτηρ Φαραὼ καὶ ἀνεθρέψατο αὐτὸν ἑαυτῇ εἰς υἱόν
verses.transliteration: ektethentos de autou aneilato auton hē thygatēr Pharaō kai anethrepsato auton heautē eis huion
verses.literal: When he was set outside Pharaoh’s daughter took him . . . and brought him up . . . as her own son
verses.literalPt: E, sendo enjeitado, tomou-o a filha de Faraó, e o criou como seu filho.

verses.original: καὶ ἐπαιδεύθη Μωϋσῆς ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ Αἰγυπτίων ἦν δὲ δυνατὸς ἐν λόγοις καὶ ἔργοις αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai epaideuthē Mōusēs en pasē sophia Aigyptiōn ēn de dynatos en logois kai ergois autou
verses.literal: So Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and was powerful in speech and action
verses.literalPt: E Moisés foi instruído em toda a ciência dos egípcios; e era poderoso em suas palavras e obras.

verses.original: Ὡς δὲ ἐπληροῦτο αὐτῷ τεσσερακονταέτης χρόνος ἀνέβη ἐπὶ τὴν καρδίαν αὐτοῦ ἐπισκέψασθαι τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: Hōs de eplērouto autō tesserakontaetēs chronos anebē epi tēn kardian autou episkepsasthai tous adelphous autou tous huious Israēl
verses.literal: When Moses was forty years old he decided . . . . . . . . . . . . to visit his brothers the children of Israel
verses.literalPt: E, quando completou a idade de quarenta anos, veio-lhe ao coração ir visitar seus irmãos, os filhos de Israel.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδών τινα ἀδικούμενον ἠμύνατο καὶ ἐποίησεν ἐκδίκησιν τῷ καταπονουμένῳ πατάξας τὸν Αἰγύπτιον
verses.transliteration: kai idōn tina adikoumenon ēmynato kai epoiēsen ekdikēsin tō kataponoumenō pataxas ton Aigyption
verses.literal: And when he saw one of them being mistreated Moses went to his defense and avenged him by striking down the Egyptian who was oppressing him
verses.literalPt: E, vendo maltratado um deles, o defendeu, e vingou o ofendido, matando o egípcio.

verses.original: ἐνόμιζεν δὲ συνιέναι τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ ὅτι ὁ Θεὸς διὰ χειρὸς αὐτοῦ δίδωσιν σωτηρίαν αὐτοῖς οἱ δὲ οὐ συνῆκαν
verses.transliteration: enomizen de synienai tous adelphous autou hoti ho Theos dia cheiros autou didōsin sōtērian autois hoi de ou synēkan
verses.literal: He assumed his brothers would understand that God was using him to deliver them but they did not
verses.literalPt: E ele cuidava que seus irmãos entenderiam que Deus lhes havia de dar a liberdade pela sua mão; mas eles não entenderam.

verses.original: Τῇ τε ἐπιούσῃ ἡμέρᾳ ὤφθη αὐτοῖς μαχομένοις καὶ συνήλλασσεν αὐτοὺς εἰς εἰρήνην εἰπών Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοί ἐστε ἱνα‿ τί ἀδικεῖτε ἀλλήλους
verses.transliteration: Tē te epiousē hēmera ōphthē autois machomenois kai synēllassen autous eis eirēnēn eipōn Andres adelphoi este hina ti adikeite allēlous
verses.literal: The next day he came upon two Israelites who were fighting and he tried to reconcile them . . . . . . . . . saying Men you are brothers Why are you mistreating each other
verses.literalPt: E no dia seguinte, pelejando eles, foi por eles visto, e quis levá-los à paz, dizendo: Homens, sois irmãos; por que vos agravais um ao outro?

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀδικῶν τὸν πλησίον ἀπώσατο αὐτὸν εἰπών Τίς σε κατέστησεν ἄρχοντα καὶ δικαστὴν ἐφ’ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ho de adikōn ton plēsion apōsato auton eipōn Tis se katestēsen archonta kai dikastēn eph’ hēmōn
verses.literal: But the man who was abusing his neighbor pushed Moses aside . . . and said Who made you ruler and judge over us
verses.literalPt: E o que ofendia o seu próximo o repeliu, dizendo: Quem te constituiu príncipe e juiz sobre nós?

verses.original: μὴ ἀνελεῖν με σὺ θέλεις ὃν τρόπον ἀνεῖλες ἐχθὲς τὸν Αἰγύπτιον
verses.transliteration: mē anelein me sy theleis hon tropon aneiles echthes ton Aigyption
verses.literal: Do you want to kill me . . . as . . . you killed the Egyptian yesterday
verses.literalPt: Queres tu matar-me, como ontem mataste o egípcio?

verses.original: ἔφυγεν δὲ Μωϋσῆς ἐν τῷ λόγῳ τούτῳ καὶ ἐγένετο πάροικος ἐν γῇ Μαδιάμ οὗ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς δύο
verses.transliteration: ephygen de Mōusēs en tō logō toutō kai egeneto paroikos en gē Madiam hou egennēsen huious dyo
verses.literal: At this remark Moses fled to the land of Midian where he lived as a foreigner and had two sons
verses.literalPt: E a esta palavra fugiu Moisés, e esteve como estrangeiro na terra de Midiã, onde gerou dois filhos.

verses.original: Καὶ πληρωθέντων ἐτῶν τεσσεράκοντα ὤφθη αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τοῦ ὄρους Σινᾶ ἄγγελος ἐν φλογὶ πυρὸς βάτου
verses.transliteration: Kai plērōthentōn etōn tesserakonta ōphthē autō en tē erēmō tou orous Sina angelos en phlogi pyros batou
verses.literal: After forty years had passed an angel appeared to Moses in the flames of a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai
verses.literalPt: E, completados quarenta anos, apareceu-lhe o anjo do Senhor no deserto do monte Sinai, numa chama de fogo no meio de uma sarça.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Μωϋσῆς ἰδὼν ἐθαύμαζεν τὸ ὅραμα προσερχομένου δὲ αὐτοῦ κατανοῆσαι ἐγένετο φωνὴ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: ho de Mōusēs idōn ethaumazen to horama proserchomenou de autou katanoēsai egeneto phōnē Kyriou
verses.literal: When Moses saw it he marveled at the sight As he approached to look more closely the voice of the Lord came to him
verses.literalPt: Então Moisés, quando viu isto, se maravilhou da visão; e, aproximando-se para observar, foi-lhe dirigida a voz do Senhor,

verses.original: Ἐγὼ ὁ Θεὸς τῶν πατέρων σου ὁ Θεὸς Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακώβ ἔντρομος δὲ γενόμενος Μωϋσῆς οὐκ ἐτόλμα κατανοῆσαι
verses.transliteration: Egō ho Theos tōn paterōn sou ho Theos Abraam kai Isaak kai Iakōb entromos de genomenos Mōusēs ouk etolma katanoēsai
verses.literal: I am the God of your fathers the God of Abraham Isaac and Jacob Moses trembled with fear and did not dare to look
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: Eu sou o Deus de teus pais, o Deus de Abraão, e o Deus de Isaque, e o Deus de Jacó. E Moisés, todo trêmulo, não ousava olhar.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ Κύριος Λῦσον τὸ ὑπόδημα τῶν ποδῶν σου ὁ γὰρ τόπος ἐφ’ ᾧ ἕστηκας γῆ ἁγία ἐστίν
verses.transliteration: Eipen de autō ho Kyrios Lyson to hypodēma tōn podōn sou ho gar topos eph’ hō hestēkas gē hagia estin
verses.literal: Then the Lord said to him Take off . . . . . . . . . your sandals for the place where you are standing is holy ground
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhe o Senhor: Tira as alparcas dos teus pés, porque o lugar em que estás é terra santa.

verses.original: ἰδὼν εἶδον τὴν κάκωσιν τοῦ λαοῦ μου τοῦ ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ τοῦ στεναγμοῦ αὐτοῦ ἤκουσα καὶ κατέβην ἐξελέσθαι αὐτούς καὶ νῦν δεῦρο ἀποστείλω σε εἰς Αἴγυπτον
verses.transliteration: idōn eidon tēn kakōsin tou laou mou tou en Aigyptō kai tou stenagmou autou ēkousa kai katebēn exelesthai autous kai nyn deuro aposteilō se eis Aigypton
verses.literal: I have indeed seen . . . the oppression of My people in Egypt I have heard their groaning and have come down to deliver them Now come I will send you back to Egypt
verses.literalPt: Tenho visto atentamente a aflição do meu povo que está no Egito, e ouvi os seus gemidos, e desci a livrá-los. Agora, pois, vem, e enviar-te-ei ao Egito.

verses.original: Τοῦτον τὸν Μωϋσῆν ὃν ἠρνήσαντο εἰπόντες Τίς σε κατέστησεν ἄρχοντα καὶ δικαστήν τοῦτον ὁ Θεὸς καὶ ἄρχοντα καὶ λυτρωτὴν ἀπέσταλκεν σὺν χειρὶ ἀγγέλου τοῦ ὀφθέντος αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ βάτῳ
verses.transliteration: Touton ton Mōusēn hon ērnēsanto eipontes Tis se katestēsen archonta kai dikastēn touton ho Theos kai archonta kai lytrōtēn apestalken syn cheiri angelou tou ophthentos autō en tē batō
verses.literal: This Moses whom they had rejected with the words Who made you ruler and judge is the one whom God sent to be their ruler and redeemer through . . . the angel who appeared to him in the bush
verses.literalPt: A este Moisés, ao qual haviam negado, dizendo: Quem te constituiu príncipe e juiz? a este enviou Deus como príncipe e libertador, pela mão do anjo que lhe aparecera na sarça.

verses.original: οὗτος ἐξήγαγεν αὐτοὺς ποιήσας τέρατα καὶ σημεῖα ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ ἐν Ἐρυθρᾷ Θαλάσσῃ καὶ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἔτη τεσσεράκοντα
verses.transliteration: houtos exēgagen autous poiēsas terata kai sēmeia en gē Aigyptō kai en Erythra Thalassē kai en tē erēmō etē tesserakonta
verses.literal: He led them out . . . and performed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt at the Red Sea and for forty years in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: Foi este que os conduziu para fora, fazendo prodígios e sinais na terra do Egito, e no Mar Vermelho, e no deserto, por quarenta anos.

verses.original: Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Μωϋσῆς ὁ εἴπας τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραήλ Προφήτην ὑμῖν ἀναστήσει ὁ Θεὸς ἐκ τῶν ἀδελφῶν ὑμῶν ὡς ἐμέ
verses.transliteration: Houtos estin ho Mōusēs ho eipas tois huiois Israēl Prophētēn hymin anastēsei ho Theos ek tōn adelphōn hymōn hōs eme
verses.literal: This is the same Moses who told the Israelites God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers
verses.literalPt: Este é aquele Moisés que disse aos filhos de Israel: O Senhor vosso Deus vos levantará dentre vossos irmãos um profeta como eu; a ele ouvireis.

verses.original: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ γενόμενος ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ μετὰ τοῦ ἀγγέλου τοῦ λαλοῦντος αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ ὄρει Σινᾶ καὶ τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ὃς ἐδέξατο λόγια ζῶντα δοῦναι ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: houtos estin ho genomenos en tē ekklēsia en tē erēmō meta tou angelou tou lalountos autō en tō orei Sina kai tōn paterōn hēmōn hos edexato logia zōnta dounai hēmin
verses.literal: He - was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai and with our fathers And he received living words to pass on to us
verses.literalPt: Este é o que esteve entre a congregação no deserto, com o anjo que lhe falava no monte Sinai, e com nossos pais, o qual recebeu as palavras de vida para no-las dar.

verses.original: ᾧ οὐκ ἠθέλησαν ὑπήκοοι γενέσθαι οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ἀλλὰ ἀπώσαντο καὶ ἐστράφησαν ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν εἰς Αἴγυπτον
verses.transliteration: hō ouk ēthelēsan hypēkooi genesthai hoi pateres hēmōn alla apōsanto kai estraphēsan en tais kardiais autōn eis Aigypton
verses.literal: But our fathers refused . . . to obey him Instead they rejected him and in their hearts turned back to Egypt
verses.literalPt: Ao qual nossos pais não quiseram obedecer, antes o rejeitaram e em seu coração se tornaram ao Egito,

verses.original: εἰπόντες τῷ Ἀαρών Ποίησον ἡμῖν θεοὺς οἳ προπορεύσονται ἡμῶν ὁ γὰρ Μωϋσῆς οὗτος ὃς ἐξήγαγεν ἡμᾶς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου οὐκ οἴδαμεν τί ἐγένετο αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: eipontes tō Aarōn Poiēson hēmin theous hoi proporeusontai hēmōn ho gar Mōusēs houtos hos exēgagen hēmas ek gēs Aigyptou ouk oidamen ti egeneto autō
verses.literal: They said to Aaron Make us gods who will go before us As for this Moses who led us . . . out of the land of Egypt we do not know what has happened to him
verses.literalPt: Dizendo a Arão: Faze-nos deuses que vão adiante de nós; porque a esse Moisés, que nos tirou da terra do Egito, não sabemos o que lhe aconteceu.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐμοσχοποίησαν ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις καὶ ἀνήγαγον θυσίαν τῷ εἰδώλῳ καὶ εὐφραίνοντο ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai emoschopoiēsan en tais hēmerais ekeinais kai anēgagon thysian tō eidōlō kai euphrainonto en tois ergois tōn cheirōn autōn
verses.literal: At that time they made a calf and offered a sacrifice to the idol rejoicing in the works of their hands
verses.literalPt: E naqueles dias fizeram o bezerro, e ofereceram sacrifícios ao ídolo, e se alegraram nas obras das suas mãos.

verses.original: ἔστρεψεν δὲ ὁ Θεὸς καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς λατρεύειν τῇ στρατιᾷ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καθὼς γέγραπται ἐν βίβλῳ τῶν προφητῶν Μὴ σφάγια καὶ θυσίας προσηνέγκατέ μοι ἔτη τεσσεράκοντα ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ οἶκος Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: estrepsen de ho Theos kai paredōken autous latreuein tē stratia tou ouranou kathōs gegraptai en biblō tōn prophētōn Mē sphagia kai thysias prosēnenkate moi etē tesserakonta en tē erēmō oikos Israēl
verses.literal: But God turned away from them and gave them over . . . to the worship of the host of heaven as it is written in the book of the prophets Did you bring Me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness O house of Israel
verses.literalPt: Mas Deus se afastou, e os abandonou a que servissem ao exército do céu, como está escrito no livro dos profetas: Porventura me oferecestes vítimas e sacrifícios No deserto por quarenta anos, ó casa de Israel?

verses.original: καὶ ἀνελάβετε τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ Μολὸχ καὶ τὸ ἄστρον τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν Ῥαιφάν τοὺς τύπους οὓς ἐποιήσατε προσκυνεῖν αὐτοῖς καὶ μετοικιῶ ὑμᾶς ἐπέκεινα Βαβυλῶνος
verses.transliteration: kai anelabete tēn skēnēn tou Moloch kai to astron tou theou hymōn Rhaiphan tous typous hous epoiēsate proskynein autois kai metoikiō hymas epekeina Babylōnos
verses.literal: You have taken along the tabernacle of Molech and the star of your god Rephan the idols you made to worship Therefore I will send you into exile . . . beyond Babylon
verses.literalPt: Antes tomastes o tabernáculo de Moloque, E a estrela do vosso deus Renfã, Figuras que vós fizestes para as adorar. Transportar-vos-ei, pois, para além da Babilônia.

verses.original: Ἡ σκηνὴ τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἦν τοῖς πατράσιν ἡμῶν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καθὼς διετάξατο ὁ λαλῶν τῷ Μωϋσῇ ποιῆσαι αὐτὴν κατὰ τὸν τύπον ὃν ἑωράκει
verses.transliteration: Hē skēnē tou martyriou ēn tois patrasin hēmōn en tē erēmō kathōs dietaxato ho lalōn tō Mōusē poiēsai autēn kata ton typon hon heōrakei
verses.literal: Our fathers had the tabernacle of the Testimony with them in the wilderness It was constructed . . . exactly as God . . . had directed Moses according to the pattern he had seen
verses.literalPt: Estava entre nossos pais no deserto o tabernáculo do testemunho, como ordenara aquele que disse a Moisés que o fizesse segundo o modelo que tinha visto.

verses.original: ἣν καὶ εἰσήγαγον διαδεξάμενοι οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν μετὰ Ἰησοῦ ἐν τῇ κατασχέσει τῶν ἐθνῶν ὧν ἐξῶσεν ὁ Θεὸς ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ἕως τῶν ἡμερῶν Δαυίδ
verses.transliteration: hēn kai eisēgagon diadexamenoi hoi pateres hēmōn meta Iēsou en tē kataschesei tōn ethnōn hōn exōsen ho Theos apo prosōpou tōn paterōn hēmōn heōs tōn hēmerōn Dauid
verses.literal: And our fathers who received it brought it in with Joshua when they dispossessed the nations - God drove out before . . . . . . them It remained until the time of David
verses.literalPt: O qual, nossos pais, recebendo-o também, o levaram com Josué quando entraram na posse das nações que Deus lançou para fora da presença de nossos pais, até aos dias de Davi,

verses.original: ὃς εὗρεν χάριν ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ᾐτήσατο εὑρεῖν σκήνωμα τῷ Θεῷ Ἰακώβ
verses.transliteration: hos heuren charin enōpion tou Theou kai ētēsato heurein skēnōma tō Theō Iakōb
verses.literal: who found favor in the sight of God and asked to provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob
verses.literalPt: Que achou graça diante de Deus, e pediu que pudesse achar tabernáculo para o Deus de Jacó.

verses.original: Σολομῶν δὲ οἰκοδόμησεν αὐτῷ οἶκον
verses.transliteration: Solomōn de oikodomēsen autō oikon
verses.literal: But it was Solomon who built the house for Him
verses.literalPt: E Salomão lhe edificou casa;

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ οὐχ ὁ Ὕψιστος ἐν χειροποιήτοις κατοικεῖ καθὼς ὁ προφήτης λέγει
verses.transliteration: All’ ouch ho Hypsistos en cheiropoiētois katoikei kathōs ho prophētēs legei
verses.literal: However the Most High does not dwell in houses made by human hands As the prophet says
verses.literalPt: Mas o Altíssimo não habita em templos feitos por mãos de homens, como diz o profeta:

verses.original: Ὁ οὐρανός μοι θρόνος ἡ δὲ γῆ ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν μου ποῖον οἶκον οἰκοδομήσετέ μοι λέγει Κύριος ἢ τίς τόπος τῆς καταπαύσεώς μου
verses.transliteration: Ho ouranos moi thronos hē de gē hypopodion tōn podōn mou poion oikon oikodomēsete moi legei Kyrios ē tis topos tēs katapauseōs mou
verses.literal: Heaven is My throne and the earth is My footstool What kind of house will you build for Me says the Lord or where will My place of repose be
verses.literalPt: O céu é o meu trono, E a terra o estrado dos meus pés. Que casa me edificareis? diz o Senhor, Ou qual é o lugar do meu repouso?

verses.original: οὐχὶ ἡ χείρ μου ἐποίησεν ταῦτα πάντα
verses.transliteration: ouchi hē cheir mou epoiēsen tauta panta
verses.literal: Has not My hand made all these things
verses.literalPt: Porventura não fez a minha mão todas estas coisas?

verses.original: Σκληροτράχηλοι καὶ ἀπερίτμητοι καρδίαις καὶ τοῖς ὠσίν ὑμεῖς ἀεὶ τῷ Πνεύματι τῷ Ἁγίῳ ἀντιπίπτετε ὡς οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν καὶ ὑμεῖς
verses.transliteration: Sklērotrachēloi kai aperitmētoi kardiais kai tois ōsin hymeis aei tō Pneumati tō Hagiō antipiptete hōs hoi pateres hymōn kai hymeis
verses.literal: You stiff-necked people with uncircumcised hearts and ears You always resist the Holy Spirit just as your fathers did
verses.literalPt: Homens de dura cerviz, e incircuncisos de coração e ouvido, vós sempre resistis ao Espírito Santo; assim vós sois como vossos pais.

verses.original: τίνα τῶν προφητῶν οὐκ ἐδίωξαν οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν καὶ ἀπέκτειναν τοὺς προκαταγγείλαντας περὶ τῆς ἐλεύσεως τοῦ Δικαίου οὗ νῦν ὑμεῖς προδόται καὶ φονεῖς ἐγένεσθε
verses.transliteration: tina tōn prophētōn ouk ediōxan hoi pateres hymōn kai apekteinan tous prokatangeilantas peri tēs eleuseōs tou Dikaiou hou nyn hymeis prodotai kai phoneis egenesthe
verses.literal: Which of the prophets did your fathers fail to persecute They even killed those who foretold . . . the coming of the Righteous One And now you are His betrayers and murderers
verses.literalPt: A qual dos profetas não perseguiram vossos pais? Até mataram os que anteriormente anunciaram a vinda do Justo, do qual vós agora fostes traidores e homicidas;

verses.original: οἵτινες ἐλάβετε τὸν νόμον εἰς διαταγὰς ἀγγέλων καὶ οὐκ ἐφυλάξατε
verses.transliteration: hoitines elabete ton nomon eis diatagas angelōn kai ouk ephylaxate
verses.literal: you who received the law ordained by angels yet have not kept it
verses.literalPt: Vós, que recebestes a lei por ordenação dos anjos, e não a guardastes.

verses.original: Ἀκούοντες δὲ ταῦτα διεπρίοντο ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν καὶ ἔβρυχον τοὺς ὀδόντας ἐπ’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Akouontes de tauta dieprionto tais kardiais autōn kai ebrychon tous odontas ep’ auton
verses.literal: On hearing this the members of the Sanhedrin were enraged . . . . . . . . . and they gnashed their teeth at him
verses.literalPt: E, ouvindo eles isto, enfureciam-se em seus corações, e rangiam os dentes contra ele.

verses.original: ὑπάρχων δὲ πλήρης Πνεύματος Ἁγίου ἀτενίσας εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εἶδεν δόξαν Θεοῦ καὶ Ἰησοῦν ἑστῶτα ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: hyparchōn de plērēs Pneumatos Hagiou atenisas eis ton ouranon eiden doxan Theou kai Iēsoun hestōta ek dexiōn tou Theou
verses.literal: But Stephen full of the Holy Spirit looked intently into heaven and saw the glory of God and Jesus standing at the right hand of God
verses.literalPt: Mas ele, estando cheio do Espírito Santo, fixando os olhos no céu, viu a glória de Deus, e Jesus, que estava à direita de Deus;

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰδοὺ θεωρῶ τοὺς οὐρανοὺς διηνοιγμένους καὶ τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκ δεξιῶν ἑστῶτα τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai eipen Idou theōrō tous ouranous diēnoigmenous kai ton Huion tou anthrōpou ek dexiōn hestōta tou Theou
verses.literal: Look he said I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God
verses.literalPt: E disse: Eis que vejo os céus abertos, e o Filho do homem, que está em pé à mão direita de Deus.

verses.original: Κράξαντες δὲ φωνῇ μεγάλῃ συνέσχον τὰ ὦτα αὐτῶν καὶ ὥρμησαν ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἐπ’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kraxantes de phōnē megalē syneschon ta ōta autōn kai hōrmēsan homothymadon ep’ auton
verses.literal: At this they covered their ears cried out in a loud voice and rushed together at him
verses.literalPt: Mas eles gritaram com grande voz, taparam os seus ouvidos, e arremeteram unânimes contra ele.

verses.original: καὶ ἐκβαλόντες ἔξω τῆς πόλεως ἐλιθοβόλουν καὶ οἱ μάρτυρες ἀπέθεντο τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν παρὰ τοὺς πόδας νεανίου καλουμένου Σαύλου
verses.transliteration: kai ekbalontes exō tēs poleōs elithoboloun kai hoi martyres apethento ta himatia autōn para tous podas neaniou kaloumenou Saulou
verses.literal: They dragged him out of the city and began to stone him Meanwhile the witnesses laid their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul
verses.literalPt: E, expulsando-o da cidade, o apedrejavam. E as testemunhas depuseram as suas capas aos pés de um jovem chamado Saulo.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐλιθοβόλουν τὸν Στέφανον ἐπικαλούμενον καὶ λέγοντα Κύριε Ἰησοῦ δέξαι τὸ πνεῦμά μου
verses.transliteration: Kai elithoboloun ton Stephanon epikaloumenon kai legonta Kyrie Iēsou dexai to pneuma mou
verses.literal: While they were stoning him Stephen appealed . . . . . . Lord Jesus receive my spirit
verses.literalPt: E apedrejaram a Estêvão que em invocação dizia: Senhor Jesus, recebe o meu espírito.

verses.original: θεὶς δὲ τὰ γόνατα ἔκραξεν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ Κύριε μὴ στήσῃς αὐτοῖς ταύτην τὴν ἁμαρτίαν καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν ἐκοιμήθη
verses.transliteration: theis de ta gonata ekraxen phōnē megalē Kyrie mē stēsēs autois tautēn tēn hamartian kai touto eipōn ekoimēthē
verses.literal: Falling on his knees he cried out in a loud voice Lord do not hold this sin against them And when he had said this he fell asleep
verses.literalPt: E, pondo-se de joelhos, clamou com grande voz: Senhor, não lhes imputes este pecado. E, tendo dito isto, adormeceu.
